titre: Mene ne sammai bakwai da kassai bakwai a cikin tafin Mai rahama, sai dai a matsayin kwaya a hannun dayanku
hadith: Daga Abdullah bn Abbas - Allah ya yarda da shi - wanda ya ce: "Mene ne sammai bakwai da kassai bakwai a cikin tafin Mai rahama, sai dai a matsayin kwaya a hannun dayanku".
attribution: Ibn Jareer ne ya Rawaito shi - Al-Thahabi Ya Rawaito shi a Babin Uluwwi (Daukakar Allah bisa Bayinsa( - Abdullahi Bn Al-Mam Ahmad Ya Rawaito shi
grade: Albani ya Rawaito Ingancin sa daga Ibn Taimiyya amma bai bibiye shi ba
explication: Ibn Abbas - Allah ya yarda da shi - ya gaya mana a cikin wannan rahoton cewa, adadin sammai bakwai da duniyoyi bakwai da kashinsu zuwa tafin Mai rahama yana kama da matsayin karamin mustard zuwa tafin dayanmu. Domin Allah baya kama da sifofinsa kamar wani abu makamancin nasa.
ar: عن عبد الله بن عباس رضي الله عنهما قال: "ما السماوات السبع والأرضون السبع في كَفِّ الرحمن إلا كَخَرْدَلَةٍ في يد أحدكم".
